title: Release a Toyota Yaris parking brake between the seats: lift, hold its button in, lower to the stop
instruction: Raise the lever slightly, hold its end button in while lowering it fully, then move both hands clear.
context: Drivers release a mechanical parking brake before driving. The full-size Yaris lever and original button sit between seat and console envelopes. One gripper holds the stock grip while the other presses the button. Release load uses on-car technician readings (by phone, Nov 2026) from a 2018 Yaris: 54 N at the grip at four clicks.
setup: Use the 2018 Yaris XP130 lever 46201-52130-C0 and bracket 46235-52040 with original grip, button and pull rod/nut. Mount at the stated pivot inside the 220 mm seat gap and 80 mm console slot. Complete fixed-mount, yoke, cartridge and guard drawings are in fixture/. On-car technician figures (by phone, Nov 2026; source in README): 54 N at four clicks and 210 mm; pull proportional to clicks; five clicks normal, about 5 degrees/click; slack 3.9 N; button 7.4 N through 8 mm. Resistance is the larger of the reported torque and the declared progressive-spring reference, plus estimated lever gravity. Two TOHATSU TM20x45 springs (54.48 N/mm each) start in series; an 8 mm front-spring stop changes the rate after 16 mm total compression. Total hard stop 22.1 mm; operating compression at most 22.0 mm. Reference rod radius 35 mm and preload 1 mm are design estimates. Enroll the complete stock-grip force curve within the declared band. Passive 50 g shoes retain combined 27/7 N m arm and 50 N finger caps. Require the 1144 backing/bush heat MTR yield>=600 MPa. One-time OEM fit, 1 kN frame, 100 N adverse, 150 N per-shoe proofs and robot duty-cycle checks are required; none is claimed performed. Reuse the enrolled assembly; reset in minutes. Lots move only a loose card.
scoring: Real trial: use synchronized 30 fps video, the protractor, a flush/out button witness mark and a 30 mm clearance reference. Show a lift off the loaded tooth, button visibly held in, hand visibly on the grip throughout descent, a supported lower tooth or bottom stop, button visibly out, and both complete hands at least 30 mm clear of the lever and button for 1 second. Final supported angle <=20 degrees: 0.25; <=16: 0.5; <=8: 0.75; bottom stop within 0.5 degree: 1.0; otherwise 0. An 8 degree fall within 0.1 s (3 frames) gives 0 permanently. Average A/B; same mechanism/load. Simulation additionally checks physical lift >=1 degree, full 8 mm button release, reengagement below 4.5 mm, <=0.25 degree cumulative unheld descent, button returned <=1.1 mm, lever speed <0.5 degree/s, button speed <2 mm/s, finite observations, sampling gaps <=5 ms, travel/mount integrity and conservative whole-hand clearance with 5 mm allowance. These are simulator integrity checks, not video precision claims. No continuous hand-force or moment scoring gate.
reset_notes: Inspect the OEM lever/button/bracket, shoes, screws, witnesses and closed guard. Set five clicks/25 degrees, button out, requested card. On-car technician figures (by phone, Nov 2026): 54 N at four clicks/210 mm, five clicks normal, 5 degrees/click; slack 3.9 N; button 7.4 N/8 mm. Lower force targets 3.9/13.5/27/40.5/54/67.5/81/94.5/98.55 N at 0/5/10/15/20/25/30/35/36.5 degrees follow the reported proportionality; zero clicks at down is assumed. Enroll the whole curve below the conservative runtime upper envelope in fixture/load-envelope-reference.json, including the declared gravity bound. Front-spring stop 8 mm, total stop 22.1 mm, operating compression <=22.0 mm; individual deflections <=14.4 mm. Weigh each complete shoe <=50 g and the rear assembly <=15 kg. Require 1144 heat MTR yield>=600 MPa. Complete OEM/guard fit, 1 kN frame, 100 N adverse and 150 N radial/5 N axial per-shoe proofs before a real trial. Button resistance is at least 7.4 N throughout 8 mm. Keep stock motor limits and qualify the complete duty cycle. Initialize the loaded 1 mm stop and full passive loads before any physics. Newly changed in-trial bounds never cross current q; existing bounds stay fixed through numerical penetration. Reuse the enrolled kit; no per-trial fabrication, cure or tuning. Physical build/proof not performed.
fidelity: Unmodified Yaris grip/button. On-car technician figures (by phone, Nov 2026): 54 N at four clicks/210 mm; five normal, 5 deg/click; button 7.4 N/8 mm. Load=max(reported, progressive reference)+extra gravity. Passive shoes, zero holding friction; combined caps 27/7 N m, 50 N. Shoulder demand estimate: peak 24.85 N m, 9 s mean 22.04 N m vs 9 N m rated. Geometry/mass/transfer estimates; physical/thermal enrollment required.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0 in both lots (2400-step limit, lever not released). Scripted demo: 1.0 in both lots (480 Hz, 39.95 s, both hands 46.8 mm clear for 1.04 s); 960 Hz comparison also 1.0/1.0. No physical trial score.
